title: Mass Spectrometry
description: Ions in a magnetic field bend by their mass: weigh them one at a time, and pick out the isotopes. Unlocks the Mass Spectrometer.

puzzle.goal: An ion of mass m and charge q is accelerated through V volts and enters a field B. Write the radius r it bends on.
puzzle.name: Magnetic rigidity
puzzle.ask: Find r in metres for a D₂ ion: m = 6.64e-27 kg, V = @{V} V, q = 1.602e-19 C, B = @{B} T.
puzzle.method: qV = ½mv² gives v; the field bends it on r = mv/(qB).
